jobs.description: Silver load of 차세대 온비드 public sale (root ADR-0280; infra/lakehouse/spark/jobs/data_go_kr_onbid.py): the Bronze objects no commit of their table records (plan-silver-load-objects, R2 alone), oldest first, each in its own commit, append to silver.onbid_real_estate_item the item conditions whose content changed and, when the pass was complete, a removal marker for each condition that left the list (root ADR-0275), and to silver.onbid_item_bid_result each result answer; and (root ADR-0340) to the announcement, announcement bid-result, announcement detail, item detail and item bid-info tables the keys whose content changed, every column mapped from data-go-kr-onbid.fields.json. Hourly, after the collector (minute 7, at most 40 minutes); `unchanged` without starting Spark when nothing is owed.

open_exception.why: Five runs reached the 40-minute limit, 2026-10-29T22:29Z to 2026-10-30T01:50Z, catching up after #943 and #945 widened the Silver rows; since then the longest run is 1,418 s. max_objects 24 is a count with no measured object time and no deadline, so the next backlog of large objects can outlive the unit again.
open_exception.tracked_by: root ADR-0386 §5: give silver_load a run_time_budget_seconds and measured_object_seconds, as rt-molit's (#988)

expected_outcome.basis: its collector changes every hour; measured 2026-11-11 from each unit's journal, 10-12..11-11 (read-only): changed 198 of 341 runs, longest gap 93.8 h, which this bound reports.
